nodes.svg_description: Large white speech bubble: a solid white rectangular panel with sharp corners and a triangular tail pointing downward at the lower-left area (tail base centered around the panel's lower third).
Three black lightning-bolt symbols (zigzag shapes) indicating sound: one large bolt angled slightly right, flanked by two smaller bolts.
Solid yellow rectangle banner behind 'NEWS', slightly rotated clockwise.
Solid red rectangle banner behind 'UPDATE', slightly rotated counter-clockwise and overlapping the yellow banner.

nodes.text: See our update on our earlier story.

nodes.svg_description: Vector illustration of a hand holding a loudspeaker. The megaphone body is red (#d32f2f) with a yellow (#ffc107) rim and handle, a small red circular back cap, and a gray cone interior edge; the hand is light gray (#e6e6e6) with a black cuff and two black buttons, attached to a yellow sleeve. The megaphone points up-left, overlapping the white panel's bottom-right corner.
